messages:
maria_g: Quick sync — launching the compact product paid funnel TOMORROW. need final checks on search ads, retarget creative swap cadence, and the webhook that forwards webinar signups to SFDC.
kevin_lee: timeline? do we have the new headline variants approved?
nora: variant A1/A2 approved. creative ready — we'll swap hero image at 48h and 24h pre-launch.
maria_g: ok cool. frequency cap stays 3/day for retargeting?
aj_sen: yes 3/day on retarget, but let's drop to 2/day for users who saw the webinar invite. lower freq for that list.
kevin_lee: pacing note — campaign has a tight budget first 72h. suggest start bids at -10% to control spend then ramp if CTR > 2.2%.
ops_jordan: tagging checklist: utm_source=google, utm_medium=cpc, utm_campaign=compact_launch_q1. Also need tracking template for search final URLs.
kevin_lee: paste tracking template?
ops_jordan: ```{lpurl}?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=compact_launch_q1&utm_term={keyword}&gclid={gclid}```
maria_g: perfect. can we route webinar signups to the inbound queue with lead score 6+ flagged?
aj_sen: ads-bot can add tags, but SFDC mapping needs the lead_score sent as custom field. @ops_jordan can you confirm webhook payload?
ops_jordan: payload example: ```{ "email": "{{email}}", "first_name": "{{fname}}", "lead_score": "{{lead_score}}", "source": "compact_launch" }``` will map to SFDC fields Compact_Lead_Score__c, Source__c.
nora: for retarget creative: rotate 3 headlines x 2 CTAs. swap hero imagery for users in cart view vs product view.
kevin_lee: also enable dynamic sitelinks for top-performing searches — saves us manual updates.
maria_g: who owns the webinar registration webhook monitoring? we had a missed post last month.
aj_sen: I'll add an alert in PagerDuty if webhook returns 5xx more than 3 times in 15m.
ops_jordan: will run a smoke test now: hitting staging endpoint with sample payload.
ops_jordan: (bot) webhook-test -> 200 OK, payload accepted, SFDC create simulated lead id 0x9a3b
kevin_lee: nice. can we add UTM+creative variant to the lead so we can do creative-level LTV later?
jm: (oops typo, ignore)
maria_g: yes include utm_campaign_variant field. ops_jordan add to mapping.
ops_jordan: done. mapping updated: utm_variant -> Campaign_Variant__c
kevin_lee: last thing — budget pacing note: set daily budget ramp: 40% day1, 70% day2, 100% day3. manual override if CPA < target.
aj_sen: noted. I'll create a small runbook for on-call to follow if spend spikes.
maria_g: thanks team. i'll post final creative assets + ad copy in the thread and tag when ready. :thumbsup:
ads-bot: (automated) Creative asset upload detected: compact_hero_v3.png added by nora
nora: uploaded ad copy doc -> https://drive.redwood/compact-launch-copy (read-only).
kevin_lee: launching bids will be in micro-batches. will update this thread with the initial hour performance snapshot.
maria_g: great — cc @growth-leads. see you at 9:30am launch standup.
